latest_final: The lost girl took shelter in an empty house and was too frightened to sleep. Through the window she saw a motionless figure outside; because it never moved, she took it for an inanimate object rather than a person. Exhaustion eventually made her sleep. In the morning, daylight showed her that the figure was in fact a real man standing at the window, his face turned toward her—he had been there all night watching her while she slept. Realizing that a stranger had observed her through the whole night while she was vulnerable and unprotected in the empty house, she fled in terror.
